artifacts_and_binary.definition: Produced or supplied artifacts, archive members and binary-derived representations retain byte identities distinct from source evidence.

build_and_deployment.definition: Build plans, environments, actions, workspaces and deployment-related checks describe how artifacts are prepared and configured.

dataflow.definition: Graph, alias and flow representations describe possible propagation and reachability while retaining each producer's precision and coverage limits.

dependencies_and_advisories.definition: Package identities, advisory feeds, SBOMs and dependency provenance support bounded supply-chain reasoning.

documents_and_retrieval.definition: Target documents and shared retrieval inventories, links and derived products organize accepted evidence without changing its authority.

history.definition: Version-control, change-log, review and deployment-history signals describe past changes without proving present behavior.

metrics.definition: Operational health, coverage, profile and accounting measurements describe observed process state rather than security conclusions.

review_products.definition: Review routing context, hypotheses, decisions, findings, developer artifacts and reports retain their original assurance and evidence-authority distinctions.

scanner_observations.definition: Scanner observations and their raw, coverage and summary artifacts retain tool judgments before review adjudication.

source_snapshot.definition: Acquisition identities, accepted source bytes and component catalogs establish what repository snapshot is in scope.

symbols_and_calls.definition: Declarations, symbols, layouts and directly resolved calls describe named program entities and their relationships.

syntax.definition: Concrete or compiler syntax trees and their bounded source backing describe program structure without claiming semantic flow.

semantics: Each catalog image whose kind is tool and each declared dataset output_kind has exactly one primary-purpose bucket.
Composite datasets keep their complete family, schema, stage, sensitivity and authority; a bucket is not an evidence claim or a permission grant.
Tool input compatibility and configured producer languages do not prove rule coverage, per-dataset language applicability or accepted run coverage.
Non-tool catalog entries, including legacy CodeQL redesign/replacement records, are not invented as canonical tool IDs; CodeQL producer datasets remain represented.

coverage.description: Report accepted-index producers, entity/relation counts, coverage, and gaps.
coverage.name: coverage

find.description: Find entities using exact structured filters.
find.name: find

list_codeql_databases.description: List the accepted CodeQL database cards (language, root, build unit, seeding mode and depth, seed ledger, coverage, gaps); pass a card's database identity to query_codeql_neighborhood. No analysis runs during retrieval.
list_codeql_databases.name: list_codeql_databases

query_artifacts.description: Query accepted produced artifacts and linked indexed evidence by exact facets.
query_artifacts.name: query_artifacts

query_build_security.description: Query accepted post-build security shards by exact scope.
query_build_security.name: query_build_security

query_change_context.description: Query accepted change-context review-priority records in rank order; they order review work and are never findings.
query_change_context.name: query_change_context

query_ci_configuration.description: Query accepted CI observations and canonical findings by exact provider and hierarchy facets.
query_ci_configuration.name: query_ci_configuration

query_code_graph.description: Query accepted, hash-verified code-graph facts (calls, sinks, entry points, paths, guards, ranges, summaries) by mode and exact subject identity; no analysis runs during retrieval and every bound reached is a gap.
query_code_graph.name: query_code_graph

query_codeql.description: Query accepted CodeQL observations by exact language, scope, rule, and source facets.
query_codeql.name: query_codeql

query_codeql_neighborhood.description: Read the precomputed call closure around one seed, symbol or observation of one CodeQL database, with the requested fact families; outside the precomputed neighborhood, depth and frontier bounds are named gaps, never absence. No analysis runs during retrieval.
query_codeql_neighborhood.name: query_codeql_neighborhood

query_dataset_inventory.description: Bounded catalog of the accepted dataset inventory: every dataset's disposition, query route, coverage and exception reason, the publication audit, and language/build-unit/input-source coverage cells.
query_dataset_inventory.name: query_dataset_inventory

query_debug_symbols.description: Query accepted build-bound DWARF/PDB evidence, not inferred call graphs. Every mode requires an exact subject or artifact identity; address and coverage require artifact_identity. Address is build-relative, unsigned and half-open. Source ranges accept verified source identities; layouts enumerate an artifact or take an exact normalized type identity.
query_debug_symbols.name: query_debug_symbols

query_hotspots.description: Query accepted priority-index hotspots in rank order, including metrics and evidence links.
query_hotspots.name: query_hotspots

query_observations.description: Filter accepted scanner observations by exact scanner, rule, normalized reported severity, suppression/duplicate state, source/artifact and location; returns native severity and the normalization rule. Tool observations are never confirmed findings; rule is the analyzer check, and seed (path:line), function, fix_it and min_trace_length select seeded Clang-Tidy / Clang Static Analyzer diagnostics.
query_observations.name: query_observations

query_owasp_workbench.description: Query accepted immutable OWASP workbench shards for one application run.
query_owasp_workbench.name: query_owasp_workbench

query_precomputed.description: Query accepted, hash-verified precomputed code facts by named set and exact subject; no analysis runs during retrieval.
query_precomputed.name: query_precomputed

query_syntax.description: Query precomputed syntax-only definitions, written calls, imports or identifier occurrences within one exact source-file or AST identity. Names and call targets are unresolved; results never establish semantic references or dataflow. No parsing or source-tree scanning runs during retrieval.
query_syntax.name: query_syntax

read_excerpt.description: Read a hash-verified excerpt for an indexed source identity.
read_excerpt.name: read_excerpt

resolve_evidence.description: Resolve an observation, evidence artifact, or finding package to supporting identities.
resolve_evidence.name: resolve_evidence

search.description: Full-text search accepted immutable evidence indexes.
search.name: search

trace.description: Traverse bounded typed relationships from one logical identity.
trace.name: trace
